description: Gradients Blitz draws differently from Chromium (BLITZ-GAPS): an angle gradient under a border, an angle gradient with background-size 200%, and conic colour stops that need the CSS fix-up (positions below an earlier one); every cell is a pixel region. The CPU renderer draws the unsorted stops as one colour, the GPU renderer as Chromium

knownGaps.pixels: blitz-paint centres angle gradients on the border box instead of the background positioning area, and does not raise colour stop positions to the largest earlier one; vello_cpu then rejects the unsorted stops (BLITZ-GAPS, gradients)
